    result = action(['SPACE'])
    ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    print(f"\nAfter SPACE {i+1}:")
    for row in range(33, 44):
        line = ascii_lines[row][25:40]
        if any(c != 'B' for c in line):
            print(f"  Row {row}: {line}")
</parameter>
</function>
